scenario: Crushing chest pressure with diaphoresis (Acute Coronary Syndrome)
patient_transcript: I have a crushing chest pressure and broke into a cold sweat

deterministic_arbiter_result.clinical_protocol: Urgent 12-lead ECG within 10 minutes of ED arrival. Serial cardiac troponins. CHEWABLE ASPIRIN 325mg if no contraindication. Maintain SpO2 > 90%.
deterministic_arbiter_result.recommended_action: Proceed immediately to the nearest Emergency Department equipped with 24/7 Cardiac Cath Lab / PCI.
